offers.name: SimpleFlex
incentives: SimpleFlex combines the freedom and flexibility you want in an energy plan with the added bonus of Cash Back*.
With XOOM Energy's Cash Back program, you earn a 5% rebate for your everyday energy use.
5% Annual Cash Back on supply charges

*Upon enrollment, your account will automatically be enrolled in the Cash Back program, and you will become eligible to receive a 5% Cash Back rebate for every $1 spent on the supply portion of your monthly residential electricity bills.

For avoidance of doubt, should you choose to change your plan within one of the 12-month periods, you will forfeit all existing cash back values for that period.  Similarly, your account must be good standing with no past due billing at the time rebate is paid.

Your Cash Back rebate will be sent to the mailing address associated with your account after every 12 consecutive months of service on the SimpleFlex plan.  Please allow 60 days after the close of every 12-month period to receive each rebate.  Rebates will be paid via check and delivered to the mailing address on your account.

Things you need to know:
*Upon enrollment, your account will automatically be enrolled in the Cash Back program, and you will become eligible to receive a 5% Cash Back rebate for every $1 spent on the supply portion of your monthly residential electricity bills.
To be eligible, you must remain active and in good standing on all qualifying accounts for 12 consecutive months.
XOOM Energy customers are active when electricity service is flowing.
For avoidance of doubt, should you choose to change your plan within one of the 12-month periods, you will forfeit all existing cash back values for that period.  Similarly, your account must be good standing with no past due billing at the time rebate is paid.
Your Cash Back rebate will be sent to the mailing address associated with your account after every 12 consecutive months of service on the SimpleFlex plan.  Please allow 60 days after the close of every 12-month period to receive each rebate.  Rebates will be paid via check and delivered to the mailing address on your account.
